payload.subject: Default arbitration decision
payload.recommendedAction: Use the paginated reader first for immediate answerability, and trigger ingest only when there is clear value beyond the current answer.
payload.avoidAction: Do not treat ingest as the first user decision.

payload.subject: Auto-schedule ingest conditions (read_then_ingest vs read_only)
payload.recommendedAction: Auto-schedule ingest only for capped read output, continued reads with offset>1, or repeated reads of the same workspace-relative file in the same live tool set.
payload.avoidAction: Otherwise keep the outcome as read_only.

payload.subject: Scope boundaries for host-side auto-ingest
payload.recommendedAction: Apply auto-ingest only to host-side reads inside the active workspace root, for likely text documents only, when the live model_memory_document_ingest tool is present and allowed.
payload.avoidAction: Do not apply this behavior to sandboxed reads.

payload.subject: When auto-ingest must not occur
payload.recommendedAction: Do not auto-ingest images, PDFs/binary files, files outside the workspace root, or when the model-memory ingest tool is not active.
payload.avoidAction: Do not attempt to auto-ingest those cases.

payload.subject: Ingest-assisted path trigger
payload.recommendedAction: Trigger ingest automatically when the document is large enough that repeated paginated reads would be wasteful, when follow-up work implies durable reuse, when it is likely to recur, when multiple queries occur in one session, or when the user asks to remember/package/reuse later.

payload.subject: Ingest suppression conditions
payload.recommendedAction: Do not auto-ingest when the document is obviously transient, when the user asks only for a quick read, when privacy/source classification says the content should remain session-local, or when a recent ingest fingerprint exists and no new chunks would be added.

payload.subject: Dedupe model keying and fingerprints
payload.recommendedAction: Dedupe using a document identity record keyed by normalized source URI/file path (when stable), content hash of fetched bytes, and ingest profile/privacy scope; use a deterministic stat-backed fingerprint (workspace-relative path, file size, file mtime) and deterministic run id and durable run record path under checkpoints/model-memory/auto-read-ingest/.

payload.subject: Reuse existing ingest record for grounding
payload.recommendedAction: If the reader touches a document that already has a current ingest record, reuse that record for chunk lookup and answer grounding, and do not re-ingest unless the content hash changed.

payload.subject: Reuse bytes and pagination metadata when ingest follows a read
payload.recommendedAction: If ingest starts after a read, reuse the already fetched bytes and pagination metadata, and avoid refetching unless the source changed.

payload.subject: User control overrides
payload.recommendedAction: Allow the user to override behavior only as an explicit override: read only, ingest for later, or do not retain this.

payload.subject: Authority of workspace path for writable surface by contract
payload.recommendedAction: Only treat a workspace path as authoritative when it is the explicit runtime-generated writable surface by contract.

payload.subject: Ownership determination for runtime project surfaces
payload.recommendedAction: Determine ownership by source of truth: repo-owned `docs/projects/*` for project docs/specs/roadmaps and related packs; repo-owned `ops/*`, `scripts/*`, and related code paths for committed automation assets; workspace-owned runtime-generated current artifacts for runtime-generated current artifacts at locations such as `projects/ops/generated_current/`; and `workspace/projects/*` compatibility aliases for old runbook paths that point back to canonical repo surfaces.

payload.subject: Compatibility alias shape preservation for legibility
payload.recommendedAction: Compatibility aliases for older runbooks must preserve enough shape to remain legible, including `INDEX.md`, `STARTUP.md`, `STATUS.md`, `CURRENT_SLICE.md`, `DECISIONS.md`, `roadmap.md`, and `specs/INDEX.md`.

payload.subject: Justified writable exception
payload.value: The only justified writable exception is `projects/ops/`, which remains a real workspace-owned compatibility surface for writable `generated_current/` and stable host cron/report entry points.

payload.subject: Every external skill review must end in a durable operator-facing report saved under docs/projects/skills-system/skill-vetting/reports/.
payload.recommendedAction: Save the durable operator-facing report to the specified directory for every external skill review.

payload.subject: Use the default report filename format docs/projects/skills-system/skill-vetting/reports/YYYY-MM-DD-<skill-slug>-review.md (or an example-<skill-slug>-review.md canonical variant).
payload.recommendedAction: Name the report using the default filename pattern, optionally using the canonical example variant path.

payload.subject: Operator vetting report must include required frontmatter fields summary, title, and review {slug, version, outcome, riskTier, generatedAt}.
payload.recommendedAction: Include the required frontmatter keys with the specified structure and allowed outcome/riskTier values.

payload.subject: Decision snapshot section must include final outcome, risk tier, short verdict sentence, install conditions, and operator recommendation.
payload.recommendedAction: In section 1 (Decision snapshot), include the required items including install conditions and operator recommendation.

payload.subject: Acquisition record section must include exact fields: skill slug, version, source, search path used, acquisition path used, whether force was required, quarantine path, and review scope mode (search_only|quarantine_review|blocked_on_acquisition).

payload.subject: Runtime surface proof section must record which surfaces were actually tested (openclaw/clawhub for host and runtime containers) with availability, proof command, and observed result.
payload.recommendedAction: In section 3 (Runtime surface proof), record host and runtime surfaces tested and for each include availability, proof command, and observed result.

payload.subject: Review evidence section must list files inspected, scripts inspected, command surfaces found, filesystem surfaces found, network surfaces found, secret/credential surfaces found, and persistence surfaces found.
payload.recommendedAction: In section 4 (Review evidence), include all listed evidence categories.

payload.subject: Risk summary section must use explicit severity tiers info|low|medium|high|critical, and each finding must include severity, surface, evidence, why it matters, and whether it blocks install.
payload.recommendedAction: In section 5 (Risk summary), use the explicit severity tiers and include the required fields for each finding including whether it blocks install.

payload.subject: Decision routing section must choose exactly one route install|inspire|reject, and include required structured follow-on fields for each route.
payload.recommendedAction: In section 6 (Decision routing), select exactly one route (install, inspire, or reject) and include the structured follow-on fields required for that route.

payload.subject: For outcome install, install_conditions must never be empty and must state where install is allowed, required binary/runtime prerequisites, and whether allowed only after a follow-up review or policy update.

payload.subject: Artifact retention: the report stays in repo docs; quarantine downloads do not stay by default; if quarantine evidence must be preserved, the report must specify what was preserved, where it was preserved, and why retention was necessary.
payload.recommendedAction: Follow the specified retention rules: keep the report in repo docs, do not retain quarantine downloads by default, and if preserving quarantine evidence, specify what, where, and why it was necessary.

payload.subject: canonical delegation target for external public-web retrieval surface
when to delegate to web research agent
payload.recommendedAction: Delegate only for external public web research, page-fact retrieval, JS-heavy site retrieval, or public-page grounded comparison/research tasks.
payload.avoidAction: Do not delegate for other purposes that do not require web retrieval.

payload.subject: when not to delegate to web research agent
payload.recommendedAction: Do not delegate for local workspace/file reading, internal skill/tool questions, or purely internal reasoning with no web retrieval need.
payload.avoidAction: Avoid delegating when no web retrieval is required.

payload.subject: canonical delegation mode for exploratory research
payload.recommendedAction: Use agent:web-researcher:main for ongoing exploratory research and for follow-up expansion when previous research context is useful.

payload.subject: delegation for explicit URL or read-this-page tasks
payload.recommendedAction: For explicit URL or “read this page/site” tasks, use a fresh temporary web-researcher session key instead of agent:web-researcher:main.

payload.subject: avoid duplicate browsing after web-researcher retrieval
payload.recommendedAction: When web-researcher already retrieved the needed information, do not independently duplicate browsing; finish with the returned structured retrieval result.
